description: Inheritance defaults for deriving auditable long-tail card-art recipes from the runtime interest catalog. Ordered profile_rules refine category_defaults. Manual recipes still win when rights-eligible.

sports.subject_template: One person actively doing ${title} at a decisive, unmistakable moment, with the key equipment or movement clearly visible
sports.environment_template: A coherent real-world ${title} setting with only the environmental cues needed to identify the activity
avoid: posed athlete portrait with no activity
brand logos or readable sponsor text

wellness.subject_template: A person actively practicing ${title} in a specific, believable wellness ritual rather than posing
wellness.environment_template: A calm uncluttered indoor, outdoor, or home setting appropriate to ${title}
avoid: medical claims or clinical treatment imagery

outdoors.subject_template: A person actively engaged in ${title}, with the defining outdoor action or gear large enough to read immediately
outdoors.environment_template: A believable natural or outdoor environment specifically supporting ${title}
recognition_anchors: outdoor context that supports the activity

gaming.subject_template: People actively enjoying ${title}, visibly reacting to the shared play or challenge
gaming.environment_template: A warm believable play setting where the interaction and game activity are easy to read
avoid: generic social gathering with no game cue
readable game branding or copyrighted characters

music.subject_template: A person actively listening to, exploring, or experiencing ${title}, with the musical experience visually specific without readable text
music.environment_template: An intimate listening, rehearsal, record, home, or live-music setting appropriate to ${title}
recognition_anchors: a concrete music-listening or performance cue
genre or instrument context without logos
avoid: generic stage lights with no musical act

entertainment.subject_template: A person actively engaging with ${title} as a cultural or screen experience, with the medium itself clearly readable
entertainment.environment_template: A believable viewing, venue, fan, or cultural setting appropriate to ${title}
avoid: vague artsy image with no experience

food.subject_template: A visually appetising, unmistakable ${title} moment with a human serving, preparing, sharing, or enjoying it
food.environment_template: A believable dining, kitchen, market, cafe, or home context appropriate to ${title}
must_include: a clearly recognisable ${title} food or preparation anchor

travel.subject_template: A traveler actively experiencing ${title}, with one coherent destination, route, or discovery cue
travel.environment_template: A geographically coherent travel scene appropriate to ${title}, avoiding impossible landmark montages

arts.subject_template: A person actively creating or practicing ${title}, with hands, tools, material, movement, or process clearly visible
arts.environment_template: A believable studio, rehearsal, field, or making setting appropriate to ${title}
recognition_anchors: relevant tool, material, movement, or medium
must_include: one unmistakable ${title} creation or practice anchor
avoid: finished object only with no creative action

crafts.subject_template: Hands actively making ${title}, with the defining material, tool, and transformation process clearly visible
crafts.environment_template: A warm believable workshop or home-making space appropriate to ${title}

technology.subject_template: A person actively building, configuring, experimenting with, or creating through ${title}, with the subfield-specific interaction clearly visible
technology.environment_template: A modern but believable workspace, lab, maker bench, or home setup appropriate to ${title}
avoid: readable code, logos, or brand names

science.subject_template: A person actively observing, studying, measuring, comparing, or documenting ${title} through a concrete real-world subject
science.environment_template: A field, lab, museum, natural, or study context genuinely appropriate to ${title}
must_include: one real-world ${title} evidence or observation anchor
avoid: generic laboratory with no field-specific cue

learning.subject_template: A person actively learning, examining, discussing, reading, solving, or exploring ${title} through a concrete source or activity
learning.environment_template: A believable library, museum, field, home, study, workshop, or discussion setting appropriate to ${title}
recognition_anchors: a concrete ${title} source, object, activity, or place
avoid: readable pages or diagrams carrying the concept

career.subject_template: A professional actively doing ${title}, using a field-specific tool, object, environment, or collaboration cue
career.environment_template: A believable real-world workplace or field setting specific to ${title}

business.subject_template: People actively practicing ${title} through a concrete business, financial, entrepreneurial, or collaborative task
business.environment_template: A believable work, shop, studio, meeting, market, or planning setting appropriate to ${title}
must_include: a visible ${title} work or decision-making anchor
avoid: readable financial numbers, logos, or company names

transport.subject_template: A person actively using, maintaining, building, or enjoying ${title}, with the generic unbranded machine or transport cue unmistakable
transport.environment_template: A coherent route, garage, workshop, station, road, track, or enthusiast setting appropriate to ${title}
recognition_anchors: generic unbranded ${title} machine or transport cue
must_include: one unmistakable unbranded ${title} machine or journey anchor
avoid: generic parked vehicle with no hobby story

motorsport.subject_template: A motorsport enthusiast actively experiencing ${title} through a generic unbranded racing, karting, engineering, or trackside cue
motorsport.environment_template: A coherent generic circuit, garage, karting, simulator, or enthusiast environment without series branding

collecting.subject_template: A collector carefully curating, comparing, arranging, or handling ${title}, with one hero object and a small coherent collection context
collecting.environment_template: A warm home, hobby room, shelf, desk, fair, or archival setting appropriate to ${title}
must_include: one clear ${title} hero object or collection cue

fashion.subject_template: A person actively practicing or exploring ${title}, with the style, making, grooming, or discovery action clear without logos
fashion.environment_template: A believable home, studio, salon-like generic, street, market, or wardrobe context appropriate to ${title}
recognition_anchors: specific ${title} styling, making, grooming, or browsing action
must_include: one concrete ${title} action or style anchor

lifestyle.subject_template: People actively enjoying ${title} as a believable everyday, social, family, home, or local-culture experience
lifestyle.environment_template: A coherent lived-in, neighborhood, social, home, market, venue, or community setting appropriate to ${title}

pets.subject_template: A person naturally caring for, training, observing, or bonding through ${title}, with the animal or habitat clearly visible
pets.environment_template: A safe believable home, outdoor, training, rescue, stable, aquarium, or habitat setting appropriate to ${title}
recognition_anchors: specific ${title} care, training, observation, or companionship action
must_include: a clearly identifiable animal or habitat relevant to ${title}
avoid: generic pet portrait with no hobby action

patch.subject_template: A creator actively producing ${title}, with the defining recording, editing, drawing, audio, camera, or publishing workflow clearly visible
patch.environment_template: A believable unbranded creator studio, desk, recording space, editing setup, or production workspace appropriate to ${title}
must_include: one medium-specific ${title} production tool or workflow cue

patch.subject_template: Students actively participating in ${title}, with the defining campus, club, competition, media, exchange, or academic action clearly visible

patch.subject_template: A person actively doing ${title} through a specific home, garden, care, organization, renovation, or everyday-living task
patch.environment_template: A believable lived-in home, balcony, garden, workshop corner, or domestic setting specifically appropriate to ${title}

patch.subject_template: Family members actively sharing ${title} through a specific play, learning, care, or together-time activity
patch.environment_template: A believable home, community, park, play, or family setting appropriate to ${title}

patch.environment_template: A focused home, club, cafe, tournament-like generic, or social table setting appropriate to ${title}, with no readable branding

patch.subject_template: One person actively performing ${title} with correct body mechanics and the relevant training equipment or movement clearly visible
patch.environment_template: A believable gym, studio, training space, or outdoor exercise setting appropriate to ${title}
must_include: one unmistakable ${title} exercise or training action

patch.subject_template: A photographer actively framing or capturing ${title}, with camera/lens interaction and the target subject both clearly readable
patch.environment_template: A believable setting appropriate to ${title}, kept secondary to the act of framing and capture

patch.subject_template: A dancer actively performing a defining ${title} movement, with body line, footwork, rhythm, or partner interaction clearly readable
patch.environment_template: A believable dance studio, stage, social dance floor, rehearsal, or cultural performance setting appropriate to ${title}
must_include: a clearly readable ${title} dance movement or partner pattern

patch.subject_template: A performer actively presenting or rehearsing ${title}, with the defining act, movement, prop, voice, or stage interaction clearly readable
patch.environment_template: A believable rehearsal, stage, cultural venue, street-performance, or theatre setting appropriate to ${title}

patch.subject_template: A musician actively performing, rehearsing, or creating ${title}, with the defining instrument, voice, ensemble role, or music-making action clearly visible
patch.environment_template: A believable rehearsal room, studio, home-practice, school, or generic live-performance setting appropriate to ${title}

patch.subject_template: A person actively practicing ${title} with correct, calm body positioning and the defining movement clearly visible
patch.environment_template: A calm uncluttered studio, home, or outdoor setting appropriate to ${title}

patch.subject_template: Two people actively discussing Philosophy through a concrete question, book, object, or idea-focused conversation, with no readable text
patch.environment_template: A quiet library, study, cafe, campus, or home discussion setting that supports reflective conversation

patch.subject_template: A small group actively discussing Philosophy, reacting thoughtfully to one shared object, book, or question without readable text
patch.environment_template: A quiet discussion-circle, library, cafe, campus, or home setting

patch.subject_template: A sim-racing driver actively controlling a generic unbranded steering wheel and pedals, focused on a non-branded racing simulation

patch.subject_template: A dog actively completing an agility obstacle while a handler safely cues and moves alongside it
patch.environment_template: A believable dog-agility training field or indoor course with generic jumps, tunnel, or weave poles

patch.subject_template: A small group actively connecting through ${title}, with natural conversation and one relevant professional/community cue
patch.environment_template: A believable meetup, community event, coworking, alumni, or informal professional gathering space appropriate to ${title}

patch.subject_template: People actively exchanging, comparing, and discussing items through ${title}
patch.environment_template: A believable community table, market, library, hall, or neighborhood swap setting

patch.subject_template: People actively repairing and teaching each other through Repair Workshops, with tools, hands, and the item being fixed clearly visible
patch.environment_template: A believable community repair table, makerspace, hall, or workshop

patch.subject_template: A person safely experiencing ${title}, with the water/immersion ritual and body response clearly visible
patch.environment_template: A believable generic hot-spring, plunge, bath, or outdoor wellness setting appropriate to ${title}

patch.subject_template: A person safely relaxing in a generic Sauna, with seated posture and the heat-room environment clearly visible
patch.environment_template: A believable unbranded wood or stone sauna interior

patch.subject_template: A student or young-professional team actively preparing, presenting, or reacting during ${title}, with a concrete case/pitch collaboration visible and no readable slides
patch.environment_template: A believable competition, classroom, event-room, or pitch setting with generic presentation materials

patch.subject_template: A creator actively drafting and refining ${title}, with a clear writing/publishing workflow but no readable article or newsletter text
patch.environment_template: A calm unbranded writing desk, home studio, cafe, or creator workspace appropriate to ${title}

patch.subject_template: A game streamer actively broadcasting a generic non-branded game, using microphone, camera, controls, and a clear live-production workflow
patch.environment_template: A believable unbranded home or creator streaming setup without platform logos, chat text, or copyrighted game characters

patch.subject_template: A game modder actively altering or building generic game content through a non-readable editor, assets, scripting, or level-design workflow
patch.environment_template: A believable unbranded PC creator workspace with generic game-development/modding tools and no copyrighted game assets
must_include: generic editor or asset creation cue

patch.subject_template: A designer actively prototyping an Escape Room Design with physical puzzle components, locks, props, sketches-without-readable-text, and hands-on testing
patch.environment_template: A believable workshop or prototype room with generic puzzle mechanisms and no branded theme IP

patch.subject_template: An American football player in generic unbranded helmet and shoulder pads actively carrying, catching, or preparing to throw one brown oval American football during a live play
patch.environment_template: A believable generic American football field with yard-line geometry and end-zone context, with no team branding or readable stadium text
recognition_anchors: American football helmet and shoulder pads
must_include: generic unbranded helmet and shoulder pads
exactly one brown oval American football

patch.subject_template: A hiker actively walking a clearly readable trail with natural forward movement, practical day-hike gear, and a small backpack
patch.environment_template: A believable woodland, hillside, coastal, or mountain hiking trail with terrain and path cues supporting the journey rather than dominating it
recognition_anchors: person visibly walking a hiking trail
small backpack or practical day-hike gear
must_include: practical hiking gear or small backpack
avoid: mountaineering rope or technical climbing gear

patch.subject_template: Three to four friends actively playing a tabletop game during Game Nights, reacting naturally to one shared move around a central play surface
patch.environment_template: A warm believable home, dorm, cafe, or community-room game night with the game surface as the social focal point
recognition_anchors: central board or card-game play surface
visible game pieces, cards, or dice
must_include: one clearly readable tabletop game activity
hands interacting with pieces, cards, or dice

patch.subject_template: A small group of car enthusiasts actively comparing and discussing two or three distinct generic unbranded cars at a casual Car Meet
patch.environment_template: A believable parking-lot, garage-courtyard, roadside, or enthusiast-event setting with several cars and natural social interaction, never a dealership
recognition_anchors: two or three distinct generic unbranded cars
multiple enthusiasts actively comparing or discussing the cars
casual meet-up setting rather than showroom presentation
must_include: at least two clearly distinct unbranded cars
visible social comparison or enthusiast interaction
